name: Tripmeter Usage
description: AI usage tracker and Verbrauch monitor for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex: Claude and Codex usage and limits, token use, 5-hour and weekly quotas, resets and API-equivalent cost. Shows where the spend went, broken down per model, skill, subagent and MCP tool. Reads the session files already on your machine — no helper CLI, no API key, nothing leaves the machine. Detects which of the two CLIs is installed and works with either one alone.
